title: Path morph
blurb: Normalizes two unrelated SVG shapes via getPathData({ normalize: true }), upgrades lines to cubics, subdivides curves to match counts, and interpolates frames through setPathData().
question: Can getPathData({ normalize: true }) and setPathData() replace a hand-written SVG path parser for D3-style morphing between arbitrary shapes?
result: Normalization removes string parsing completely; after converting L to C and subdividing to equal segment counts, value-by-value interpolation renders through setPathData() (verified behind flag in Chrome 153; not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI; not verified in Chrome 160
